title.zh: 有条件统一基础的五项验收
title.en: Five-condition acceptance of the conditional foundation

claim.zh: 既有审查认为候选在显式局部规律与规范前提下满足其原五项完成条件。
claim.en: The existing review assesses the candidate as meeting its original five completion conditions under explicit local laws and normative premises.

hypotheses.zh: 固定完成范围；接受的机制、评价形成、正当应用及组合对应各保留原条件。
hypotheses.en: The fixed completion scope; accepted mechanisms, formed evaluation, warranted application and composition retain their respective premises.

correspondence.zh: 验收区分已接合历史、有条件传输与分别实现；并非所有模型同一世界的证明。
correspondence.en: The assessment distinguishes joined histories, conditional transport and separate realizations; it is not a proof that every model is one realized world.

detail.zh: 条件基础完成不完成更强无公理规范目标。
detail.en: Conditional foundation completion does not finish the stronger axiom-free normative target.

detail.zh: 有条件实践智慧不等于核心唯一必要性的证明。
detail.en: Conditional practical wisdom is not a proof of the core’s exclusive necessity.

detail.zh: 不证明普遍经验真、唯一形而上必然性、一般道德可靠性或完整治理。
detail.en: It establishes neither universal empirical truth, exclusive metaphysical necessity, general moral reliability nor completed governance.

limitations.zh: 不证明普遍经验真、唯一形而上必然性、一般道德可靠性或完整治理。
limitations.en: It establishes neither universal empirical truth, exclusive metaphysical necessity, general moral reliability nor completed governance.

validation_scope.zh: 登记已有范围审查与验收，不把多次验收计作多个基础结果；本次未作新科学验证。
validation_scope.en: Registers the existing scoped assessment and acceptance; repeated acceptances are not separate foundation results. No new scientific validation.

next_delta.zh: 直接复用已完成候选；更强目标应写清新增完成条件。
next_delta.en: Reuse the completed candidate; stronger targets must state their additional completion conditions.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
